sentence: No confirmed narrowband carrier is found: of 56 threshold crossings 18 are attributable to molecular lines and the 31 remaining unattributed ones are consistent with the 24.6 predicted by the fields' own control positions (P = 0.13), while none of the 33 testable crossings recurred -- setting a typical single-epoch completeness limit of 1.5e15 W EIRP for the median system, with coverage (21 systems have no repeat epoch) limiting the search more than depth.
